title: Flow Node Rendering Cleanup
description: Refactor flow node rendering: map widgets to native DAG node kinds, remove overlay, fix label centering and handle overlap, LOD-driven progressive disclosure.
summary: Refactored flow node rendering for clean, consistent widgets. Flow widgets now map to native DAG node kinds (Slider, Note, Preview, Action, Computation) instead of generic computation boxes with a paint overlay. Removed paint_flow_widget_chrome and duplicate slider pointer handling from flow core; slider drag uses native DAG interaction with sync back to fixture widgets. Added Note/Preview/Action to DagNodeKind with dedicated paint paths. Fixed vertical label centering via label_extent helper in cavas. Fixed port label/handle overlap by insetting labels. LOD progressive disclosure: Normal shows controls only; Detail adds names/values; Micro adds port labels. Section dividers limited to computation nodes. All Rust tests pass (dag 20, flow 13, cavas 5); flow react vitest 12 pass. WASM rebuilt for dag and flow core.
